chapter_title_ka: თინათინისაგან ავთანდილის გაგზავნა მის ყმის საძებრად
chapter_title_en: Tinatin Sends Avtandil in Quest of the Knight
chapter_expert_explanation_en: Queen Tinatin summons Avtandil to their first private meeting, acknowledges his hidden courtly love for her, and commands him as her vassal and lover ('First thou art a knight... second, thou art my lover', Stanza 130) to search for the Knight in the Panther's Skin for three years, swearing an oath to wed none but Avtandil. Avtandil confides in his loyal retainer Shermadin and appoints him regent of his domain.
